intent.outcome: Make protected master and the release workflows fail closed on one exact-commit, exact-artifact support-bearing promotion result.
non_goals: Do not create a generic hosted release service or duplicate domain checkers.
Do not claim #2448 closed until every release-critical child and a public rehearsal are complete.
Do not make canary or local development artifacts subject to the support-bearing gate.

Required CI and release matrices cover Python 3.13/3.14, Windows/Linux, Node 20/24/25 as declared, frozen lock verification, full root inventory, timeouts, and least privilege.
requirements: Inspect live GitHub ruleset and required-check state after applying it.
